tweet.text:
Up until AI, driving coverage high, and making it real, had been considered so laborious as to be impractical for most projects. But AI trivializes the labor. High, meaningful coverage is within easy reach of even the most casual projects. 

So the question is no longer about the relative necessity of high coverage. Nowadays it’s tantamount to adolescent carelessness to ignore it.
